messages:
Elena (CS Ops): Heads up: noticed a batch of accounts with bogus trial activity duplicates from Zapier connector. Affected ~180 accounts, healthscore dropped incorrectly because churn trigger fired twice.

Ravi (CS Tools): Can you paste a sample event id?

Elena (CS Ops): sample: zap_evt_55f3. Payloads identical except `attempt_uuid`. snippet:
``n2026-03-22T11:12:01Z received zap_evt_55f3 account=acct_110 attempt=1
2026-03-22T11:12:03Z received zap_evt_55f3 account=acct_110 attempt=2
``n
Maya (Data): If churn trigger uses recent activity window it double-counted. We should debounce identical event types per account for 1h in scorer.

Ravi (CS Tools): Quick mitigation: add ingress idempotency on (vendor, event_fingerprint) and a temporary scorer heuristic: ignore repeated event_type if identical payload_hash within 1h. Long-term: add unique index and backfill.

Jon (Enablement): Also want to prevent renewal playbooks firing on noisy diffs. Can we add playbook gate: require health change > threshold for >24h before sending renewal outreach?

Ravi (CS Tools): Yes — propose `renewal-suppress-if-spike` rule: aggregate day-over-day delta and debounce alerts for 24h. We can toggle via feature flag and test with a small cohort.

playbook-bot: Draft playbook created: `renewal-alert-stability-v1` (creator: Jon). Link: https://console.redwood/playbooks/renewal-alert-stability-v1

Elena (CS Ops): Plan: 1) ingress dedupe patch tonight (safe deploy), 2) scoring debounce + playbook gate behind flag, 3) backfill micro-recalc for tagged accounts overnight. Maya will run preflight counts. Ravi will prepare dedupe migration script.

Maya (Data): Preflight: estimated recalc for 180 accounts (30d window) ~ <5min; will post numbers.

Ravi (CS Tools): I'll add a dry-run that tags suspected duplicates as `zap_dupe_candidate` before any deletes.

Elena (CS Ops): Thanks all. Drop any more sample `zap_evt` ids here. I'll compile an ops note and schedule the backfill. :memo:
notes: Slack thread: Zapier connector created duplicate trial activities causing transient healthscore drops. Coordinated mitigation: ingress idempotency, scoring debounce, playbook suppression, and micro-recalc backfill. Participants: CS Ops, CS Tools, Data, Enablement.
